description: This Java class defines a set of constants and utility methods used throughout the Tenant API in the Eclipse Hono project. It specifies configuration field names, default values, property names, API endpoint, and tenant actions, aiding in standardization and consistency across the codebase.

classes.name: TenantConstants
classes.description: Final utility class containing constants and nested enums relevant to tenant configuration and API actions.

methods.name: TenantAction.from
methods.description: Creates a TenantAction enum value from a string subject; defaults to custom if input is invalid.
